title: To revise the boundaries of certain John H. Chafee Coastal Barrier Resources System units in Florida.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on February 9, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

This bill modifies certain boundaries of the John H. Chafee Coastal Barrier Resources System Units located in Collier County, Florida.

summary.headline: This 2016 law changes the mapped boundaries of certain protected coastal barrier units in Collier County, Florida.
summary.what_it_does: The law revises the boundaries of some units in the John H. Chafee Coastal Barrier Resources System located in Collier County, Florida. The system is a federal map of undeveloped coastal areas. Changing a unit's boundary changes which specific parcels of land fall inside or outside the mapped area. The official summary does not list which parcels are affected.

who_it_affects.group: Owners of land in the affected Collier County coastal units
who_it_affects.how: Whether their property is inside or outside the revised boundary can change how federal rules and programs, such as federal flood insurance and certain federal spending, apply to it.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy or build homes near Collier County's coast
who_it_affects.how: Changed boundaries may affect whether federal flood insurance or federal funding is available for projects on nearby land.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not state a specific effective date, so it is likely to take effect when it was enacted on February 29, 2016.
